facts.rationale: The positive branch's inline explicitly selects state 1 rather than holding state 2.
facts.value: Samples Bellossom's dynamic bone 1 during numeric state 2 and, when model animation activity ceases, postdecrements its lifetime. An old nonpositive lifetime enters ending state 4; an old positive lifetime selects numeric state 1 with animation updating and restores effect hitlag callbacks. It always returns false.

evidence.why: Other state-1 entries perform additional resets.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claimed timer-controlled hold and preserves postdecrement semantics and numeric-state ambiguity.
facts.value: Every invocation samples dynamic bone 1. While it_80272C6C reports active animation, this callback does not change the lifetime or numeric state. Otherwise it postdecrements timer_unk0 and tests its old value: old <= 0 invokes it_802D0774 to enter state 4; old > 0 selects state 1 through the inline. The latter transition requires no landing test and does not perform the velocity or fall-speed resets used by the other state-1 entry paths. The callback always returns false.

facts.rationale: Both definition and header spell HSD_GObj*, not Item_GObj*.
facts.value: Bellossom item-state entry routine with exact canonical signature void(HSD_GObj* gobj); it retrieves the Item payload, selects numeric state 2 and returns no value.

evidence.why: Animation true is consumed as removal.

facts.rationale: Adds the omitted state-2 animation transition, distinguishes pre/postdecrement and preserves exceptional landing behavior without claiming compiled layout.
facts.value: The five source entries dispatch numeric states 0 through 4. State 0 delegates initial landing to a state-1 entry. State 1, when animation activity ceases, predecrements lifetime and enters state 3 on a nonpositive result or restarts state 1 otherwise. Its collision callback enters state 2 only when the floor query fails and saved x70 < 0 while current x8 > 0. State 2, when animation activity ceases, postdecrements lifetime: an old nonpositive value enters state 4, while an old positive value selects state 1 without requiring landing. Its qualified landing callback also enters state 1. State 3 enters state 4 under the same strict floor/sign conjunction; state 4's qualified landing callback enters state 3. States 3 and 4 return true when model animation activity ceases, requesting removal. Shared landing processing can suppress the supplied callback through additional predicates, destruction or entered_air handling.

evidence.why: Recurring effect and random two-cue branch.

facts.rationale: Retains the established gameplay correspondence while correcting deterministic alternation to random selection.
facts.value: Supplies recurring bone-attached effect presentation and randomly selected audio cues during the sustained phase mapped to Bellossom's Sweet Scent dance. The wider attack is associated with sleep-inducing powder; this callback itself schedules effect, audio and movement processing rather than directly applying sleep. Its two audio cues need not alternate.

facts.rationale: Corrects the effect argument's meaning and makes the root-motion-to-falling overwrite explicit.
facts.value: Resolves the Item from gobj and predecrements kireihana.timer_unk1. At exactly zero it passes effect 0x470, gobj, dynamic bone 2 and scale divisor 2.6f to it_8027ADEC, which supplies item scale divided by 2.6f to efSync_Spawn; it then reloads the timer from special attribute x8. It unconditionally invokes it_8027A344 to apply root-motion velocity, adds common attribute x10_fall_speed to the persistent Kireihana fall_speed accumulator, caps it only from above at x14_fall_speed_max and overwrites velocity y with its negative. This callback does not advance timer_unk2.

evidence.why: Velocity acceptance, entered_air and destruction branches.

facts.rationale: Removes the unsupported survival guarantee and preserves cross-file exceptional branches.
facts.value: Delegates state-2 terrain processing to it_8026E248 with it_802D01A0 as the supplied landing event, then returns false. A qualifying landing invokes that event to select state 1 with hit preservation, restore effect hitlag callbacks, sample bone 1 and reset fall speed. The shared helper also resolves terrain and evaluates landing-count, velocity and landing-finalization predicates. Its predicate chain can destroy the item or invoke entered_air handling instead of the supplied callback, so failure to invoke it_802D01A0 does not guarantee that state 2 continues.
